blocks.arabic_text: يَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلَاةَ الَّتِي بَعْدَهَا إِلَّا قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ: اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْلَهُ اَللّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ asked, “Shall I tell you of a deed that erases your sins and increases your good deeds?” the Sahabah requested, “O Rasulullah, please do tell us!” “Making Wudu well when the heart does not wish to (in the cold season), walking much towards the masjid, waiting for the next Salah after one Salah; whoever makes Wudu at his home, goes to the masjid, prays in congregation with the Muslims, and then waits for the next Salah, the angels make Du'a for him, “O Allah, forgive him! O Allah, have mercy on him!”” Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: أَلَا أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَي مَا يَمْحُو اللهُ بِهِ الْخَطَايَا وَيَرْفَعُ بِهِ الدَّرَجَاتِ؟ قَالُوا: بَلَي، يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! قَالَ: إِسْبَاغُ الْوُضُوءِ عَلَي الْمَكَارِهِ، وَكَثْرَةُ الْخُطَا إِلَي الْمَسَاجِدِ، وَانْتِظَارُالصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ ، فَذلِكُمُ الرِّبَاطُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب فضل اسباغ الوضوء علي المكاره، رقم:٥٨٧
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ asked, “Shall I teach you the deed that becomes the means for Allah to erase your sins and raise your ranks?” the Sahabah requested, “O Rasulullah! Please do teach us!” “Making Wudu perfectly even at difficult times, walking much towards the masjids, waiting for the next Salah after one Salah — these, in truth, are Ribat,” the Prophet ﷺ
